items.label: la drogue
items.scene: The word DROGUE, a harmful DRUG (said DROG), is engraved on a brass wall plaque by the locked cabinet; the word for medicine is médicament.

items.label: l'aiguille
items.scene: A GOOEY ("ay-GWEE") marshmallow sits stuck on the tip of a giant knitting NEEDLE that a granny is using.

items.label: la pilule
items.scene: A giant soft PILL-shaped cushion LULLS ("LEWL") a hamster to sleep on the table.

items.label: le traitement
items.scene: A MAN ("MAHN") carries a TRAY ("treh") of TREATMENT, hot towels and a warm drink, to a sneezing bear.

items.label: le flacon
items.scene: The pharmacist fills a tiny glass VIAL through a paper CONE ("KOHN") funnel, and a mouse peeks inside.

items.label: le plâtre
items.scene: A golden puppy proudly holds up his PLASTER cast covered in paw prints, right beside the shiny silver PLATTER ("PLAHTR") on the worktable.

items.label: le comprimé
items.scene: A rabbit pulls the lever of a big brass press that squashes white powder into a round TABLET: COMPRESSED ("kohn-pree-MAY")!
